subject: ddl: record the used indexID for global-sort reorg (#53975)
summary: Adds `ele_ids` into global-sort backfill subtask metadata and propagates it through read-index/merge-sort/ingest planning so cloud import can attribute duplicate-key errors to the correct index (with a fallback path for old subtasks without `ele_ids`). Reviewed the DDL distributed reorg metadata flow and executor/scheduler usage for correctness/compat/concurrency-sensitive state handling; no Blocker/High issues found in the touched paths.
